ticket.summary: [BE] Products stock list returns soft-deleted trade items — trade-item.service

text.description:
⚠️ SANDBOX / TOOLING FIXTURE for /spec (backend Vitest). Targets a plausible backend read-path bug for demo. Safe to cancel/delete after validation.

## Summary

The products-stock read path returns trade items whose `deletedAt` is set, so soft-deleted products still appear in the stock list. Reads must exclude `deletedAt != null` (soft-delete rule).

## Environment

* Env: staging
* Tenant / workspace ID: <redacted>
* Time observed: 2026-08-20T10:00Z

## Steps to reproduce

1. In a workspace that has at least one soft-deleted trade item (`deletedAt` set).
2. Read the products-stock list endpoint.
3. Inspect the returned rows.

## Expected

Only trade items with `deletedAt: null` are returned.

## Actual

Soft-deleted trade items (`deletedAt` set) are included in the list.

## Impact

* Users affected: all workspaces that have soft-deleted any product.
* Data correctness: display-only (no writes) — shows removed products.
* Reversibility: fix + re-query; no migration.
* Frequency: always, when soft-deleted items exist.

## Root cause hypothesis

A find query in the trade-item read path is missing the `deletedAt: null` filter. Grep callers of the shared find helper; fix at the shared function, not one caller.

## Regression risk

Other reads sharing the same trade-item find helper (movements list, KPI aggregation).
